title: 冷凍庫裝不下
subject: a woman who meal-preps twenty-one lunch boxes every Sunday night and plays Tetris to fit them into the tiny freezer of her shared flat, evicting her flatmate's ice cream tub one box at a time
caption: Mandarin nu-disco with Nile Rodgers-style funk guitar. Octave-jumping slap bass, choppy muted rhythm guitar, four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hat, short string-section stabs, Rhodes chords. Warm polished mix with a bit of tape saturation. Female mid-register vocal, bright and clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, A minor. Playful Sunday-night kitchen mood. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drops, no rap, no ballad slowdown.
lyrics:
[Intro - slap bass, string stabs, funk guitar]

[Verse 1]
星期天晚上十一點
二十一個便當排一排
雞胸肉配花椰菜
每盒都寫上星期幾

[Pre-Chorus]
冷凍庫只有一個抽屜
我把它當方塊在玩

[Chorus]
轉一下 推進去
星期三卡在星期一
室友的冰淇淋
對不起 請你先出去

[Verse 2]
她在門口叉著腰
問我是不是要開店
我說這叫做規劃
其實我只是懶得煮

[Pre-Chorus]
最後一盒還差一公分
我用膝蓋輕輕地推

[Chorus]
轉一下 推進去
星期五疊在星期四
室友的冰淇淋
今晚就搬進我肚子裡

[Outro - strings, slap bass fade]
下週我買一個新冰箱
